v6_new_blockers.name: distinct_codex_turn_identity_collision
v6_new_blockers.detail: V6 response_request_fingerprint omitted client_metadata.turn_id. Two intentional turns with identical model/input/tools/request_kind but different turn_id produced the same fingerprint, so a new turn could receive an old durable replay instead of invoking the provider.

v6_new_blockers.name: late_retry_after_conversation_advance_can_replan_old_tool
v6_new_blockers.detail: A single latest replay slot is insufficient. Once turn B replaces turn A's replay, a delayed retry of A can otherwise miss the replay and re-enter provider planning. V7 retains bounded prior request fingerprints as tombstones so stale retries fail closed.

changes: request fingerprint binds Codex turn_id as well as request_kind and response-shaping fields
same-turn retry keeps a stable fingerprint
previous committed request fingerprints are retained as bounded tombstones
durable_required rejects a missing conversation identity or non-persistent store
failed durable publication restores prior in-memory state and blocks replay
legacy v2 exact retry remains fail-closed

proved: fresh non-stream tool response then exact retry calls provider once and preserves response_id/item_id/call_id
distinct same-text Codex turn invokes provider again
delayed retry of older committed turn is tombstoned and cannot replan
stream emits only identity-free SSE comments before durable publication
stream then non-stream exact retry reuses one canonical response
forced disk failure publishes no transient cache/client tool response and a retry does not call provider again while persistence is blocked
